findings.description: Interactive selection subsystem (UniversalSelector) deleted as dead code in 1c6350e; 13 live call sites raise AttributeError, swallowed and reported as success.
continue_selection and test_echo dead-letter to the handler; the parity test meant to catch this was disabled by an unverified BRIDGE_ONLY_TOOLS exemption.
Production _scan_discovery mass-deletes forward-compat discovery records missing socket_path; the canonical (test-only) implementation correctly preserves them.
CAM StepDown/FinalDepth silently revert to SetupSheet expression defaults on recompute because the bound expression is never cleared before setting the value.
_create_path_op silently drops the caller's face/edge selection when base_object doesn't resolve; falls back to whole-model exterior or a near-empty toolpath.
linear_pattern with an unrecognized direction stacks every copy coincident (all offsets are (0,0,0)) yet reports success — coincident-face OCCT crash pathology.
create_wedge is the only primitive that skips dimensional validation; inverted/zero bounds return success.
polar_array reads the axis parameter and never passes it through to Draft.make_polar_array.
freecad_available() returns True on Windows unconditionally, with no socket probe.
capture_freecad_state captures Name/TypeId/Label only — no Placement, Shape validity/bbox, PropertiesList, or State — on every crash log.
Binary STL parser never checks the file is actually binary STL before struct-unpacking it; drives real CNC toolpaths.
Zero test coverage (invisible in the coverage table entirely), hardcoded alias allow-list with bare except, always-True confirmation stub, wrong-axis bbox matching.

Six independent 'resolve identifier -> object' implementations, three of them first-match-wins on duplicate Label instead of BaseHandler.get_object()'s canonical raise.
SketchBuilderOpsHandler was the only handler class not inheriting BaseHandler — no get_object()/_validate_file_path()/log_and_return().
MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE defined three times with no parity test; the test file's own copy shadowed the imported constant.
Post-recompute Invalid-state check existed on only 2 of ~22 PartDesign feature-creating methods.
Invalid plane/axis/direction strings silently default to a fallback vector while the response message echoes the invalid request as if it were honored.
Sibling pgrep implementations disagree on FreeCAD process-name capitalization; one false-negatives, the other could SIGKILL an unrelated process.
A session-scoped autouse pytest.skip() catches every infrastructure failure; all integration tests skip and CI reports green.
FreeCAD/Part/Sketcher/Draft/Mesh/Path.* test mocks were bare MagicMock() with no spec=; any typo'd API call auto-vivified and 'succeeded'.
Two test files mutate the shared FreeCAD.Vector mock singleton at module level; whichever sorts last in pytest collection wins for every test that doesn't reset it.
Socket fd leak on connect() failure — no close() in the except branch; no Windows liveness pre-check at all.
execute_python has no try/except around json.loads of the poll response; a non-JSON reply propagates out of handle_call_tool, bypassing crash diagnosis.
Health monitor always probes the legacy default socket path rather than the active instance's actual socket_path under the multi-instance architecture.
mm/min->mm/s conversion hand-written ~8 times, column-letter conversion reimplemented 4 times, part_ops loft/sweep duplicates partdesign_ops near line-for-line — no parity tests.
Stepover never validated against tool diameter in most CAM paths; StepOver>=100 leaves uncut ridges.
Untested high-risk surface: 8 zero-coverage partdesign functions, entire ocl_surface_op.py module, macro_ops confirmed gate, spreadsheet_ops.get_cell_range.

Five diagnostic-capture sites silently drop data: .ips asi field, log_operation error-branch parameters/duration, macro stdout/stderr on crash, get_object_properties type collapsing, unvalidated request envelope + discarded send_message return.
Fixture regression tool's topology capture is invariant under the exact mirror/chirality-flip bug it was built to catch; CenterOfMass (which would shift) was never captured.
lines[-count:] with count=0 returns the entire buffer instead of nothing; negative reads from the front. Affects _get_debug_logs and _get_last_traceback.
